primitives.name: Source Visibility Control
primitives.verbatim_quote: Sources within a scene have individual visibility toggles, position, size, and filters applied.
primitives.assumptions: Each source operates independently with fixed spatial attributes.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When V_s = false, S_s and P_s are undefined.

layer2.mapping: Scene graph node in GSE maps to source control in GSI via visibility state.
layer2.telemetry: Operator toggle state and rendered output consistency

primitives.name: Data Provenance Governance
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Data provenance**: The data displayed must come from a T1/T2/T3 source in the Source Acquisition Mesh.
primitives.assumptions: Only T1–T3 sources are considered trustworthy for public media.

layer2.mapping: GSI's claim validation kernel derives trustworthiness from T-tier assignment.
layer2.telemetry: Source tier badge overlay integrity check

primitives.name: Freshness Timestamping
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Freshness disclosure**: Any live or near-live data displayed (odds, injury status, pick status) must show a timestamp confirming when it was last updated.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t_u': 'update timestamp (seconds since epoch)', 't_c': 'current time (seconds since epoch)', 'Δt': 'time delta (seconds)'}
primitives.assumptions: Data is stale if Δt exceeds threshold τ.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If Δt > τ, data is flagged or suppressed.

layer2.mapping: GSE's freshness filter computes Δt and enforces labeling or removal.

reasoning_traces.think:
The scene system models a compositional logic where each source contributes to an observable outcome through defined controls and constraints. The operator acts as a probabilistic agent selecting among scenes based on data credibility and temporal freshness. Each source is evaluated under a Bayesian lens: T-tier determines prior probability of trustworthiness, while timestamps inform posterior update. The system enforces a dual constraint—data must be both credible and current. Failure modes include stale data exposure, unauthorized T5/T6 data inclusion, or unfiltered forbidden language. These risks are mitigated through operator review, automated filtering, and explicit governance scans. The architecture supports retroactive traceability via source metadata and audit trails.
